title: G35 · 拒绝
body: I retained the proven matrix, LIS, two-sum, and prime kernels, but changed topK to use an allocation-bounded numeric typed sort, mergeIntervals to sort exactly packed integer endpoint keys instead of comparator-sorting temporary pairs, dedupe to use an open-addressed integer table for large numeric ranges, and wordFreqTopK to sort stable IDs rather than allocating one pair per vocabulary item. These are independent, semantics-preserving changes aimed primarily at the two tasks with clear comparator/allocation overhead; together they should provide enough paired product to clear the required 5% aggregate margin while retaining explicit fallbacks for unsupported numeric forms and edge cases.
